name: Catholic Monarchy (until 1516)
description: A quartered banner of the arms of the Catholic Monarchs: the castle and lion of Castile and León quartered with the bars of Aragon and the eagles of Sicily, with the pomegranate of Granada at the base.
history: Royal banner of the Catholic Monarchs Ferdinand and Isabella, used from the union of the crowns in 1479.

features.role: arms of Castile, León, Aragon and Sicily
